name: Quantity Discounts & Bulk Pricing for WooCommerce
author: Muhammad Riaz

sections.description:
Quantity Discounts & Bulk Pricing for WooCommerce (by Attizaz) is a lightweight WooCommerce discount plugin that helps you sell more with automatic quantity discounts and bulk pricing. Set simple “buy more, save more” pricing tiers on your products and let discounts apply automatically in the cart and at checkout — no coupon codes needed.

Reward customers for buying more. For example: buy 1 at the standard price, buy 2 and save 10%, buy 3 and save 15%. The more they add to the cart, the more they save — which naturally increases your WooCommerce average order value.

Why use Quantity Discounts & Bulk Pricing for WooCommerce?

  • Automatic quantity discounts – reward customers with tiered “buy more, save more” pricing (e.g. buy 2 save 10%, buy 3 save 15%).
  • Percentage or flat discounts – set each tier as a percentage off or a flat amount off.
  • Multiple discount tiers – add as many “buy N” tiers as you need.
  • No coupon codes – discounts apply automatically in the cart and at checkout.
  • Increase average order value – encourage customers to add more to every order.
  • Works with your existing products – add discount tiers in seconds.
  • Live preview – see your discount tiers as you set them up.
  • Lightweight and fast – built to keep your store quick and clean.
  • Translation ready – fully localizable for any language.

Key features

  • Quantity-based (tiered) discounts – buy more, save more
  • Percentage (% off) and flat-amount discount types
  • Multiple discount tiers (buy 1, buy 2, buy 3, and more)
  • Automatic discounts at cart and checkout (no coupons)
  • Simple, beginner-friendly setup with a live preview
  • Compatible with the latest WooCommerce and WordPress versions

Go Pro — Discounts & Bulk Pricing for WooCommerce Pro

Upgrade to Discounts & Bulk Pricing for WooCommerce Pro to unlock more ways to convert and stand out:

  • 3 widget styles – choose Classic Card, Staircase Pricing, or Segmented Pill Row.
  • Multiple color theme presets – match the discount widget to your store branding.
  • Countdown timer – add urgency with a “Hurry, offer ends in…” timer.
  • Specific price discount type – set an exact fixed price per tier.
  • Priority support.

Get Discounts & Bulk Pricing for WooCommerce Pro »
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/attizaz-sales-booster-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to the plugin settings to create your first quantity discount rule.
  5. Save — your discounts now apply automatically at checkout.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce to use this plugin?

Yes. This plugin requires an active WooCommerce installation.

Do customers need a coupon code to get the discount?

No. All discounts are applied automatically in the cart and at checkout — no coupon codes required.

Can I set different discounts for different quantities?

Yes. You can create tiered quantity discounts, for example “buy 2 save 10%, buy 3 save 15%”.

What discount types are supported in the free version?

Each tier can be a percentage off or a flat amount off.

Can I change the widget style or add a countdown timer?

Additional widget styles, color theme presets, a countdown timer, and specific-price discounts are available in the Pro version, Discounts & Bulk Pricing for WooCommerce Pro.

Will it slow down my store?

No. The plugin is built to be lightweight and only runs its logic where needed.
